text:
alex: QBR item: propose a short playbook to reweight MDF toward marketplace listing credits for the NexusHW cohort. Need audit + scorecard tweak + guardrails by Thu. :spiral_calendar:
maria: I can run the partner-health audit (usage, activation, marketplace vs direct leads). Will pull cohort and flag pilots. ETA Thu EOD.
jon: I9ll draft the scorecard changes. Thinking: +12 pts marketplace_activation, +6 pts pipeline_velocity, -8 pts generic-demand to keep total = 100.
vivian: Ops note: we must include per-partner daily caps and a conversion watch (pause if <10% after 45 days). Can implement via automation.
acct-bot: Finance: two pilot commitments lock 35k. Remaining co-marketing MDF ~160k. We can reassign up to 60k without contract amendments. Will need PO change if we reallocate.
maria: Audit quick hits: 3 of 7 partners missing getting-started guide; marketplace listing conversion lags reseller channel by ~22% (cohort data in sheet). Uploading CSV now.
alex: For the QBR we need: (1) a one-line customer rationale, (2) numeric impact for 30% and 50% reweight scenarios, (3) contingency plan.
jon: One-liner draft: "Temporarily redirect a portion of co-marketing MDF to marketplace listing credits to boost discoverability and shorten lead-to-pipeline time for NexusHW partners."
vivian: Guardrails: per-partner daily cap = 2k credits, monthly group cap = 45k, automated pause and notify if 30-day conversion <10%. Include rollback path to co-marketing pool.
acct-bot: Reminder: QBR packet due 2024-06-12T17:00Z. Please upload to /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/
alex: Action owners recap: @maria audit + numbers, @jon scorecard + one-liner, @vivian guardrails, @acct-bot finance PO template. Quick check: anyone blocked on timing?
maria: I9ll have audit + calc for 30/50pct by Thu EOD.
jon: Scorecard delta by Thu morning.
vivian: Guardrail automation draft by Fri AM.
alex: Perfect 44d small sync Friday to finalize the recommendation. Calendar invite shortly.
